section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study (Study 1) examining the psychometric properties of a Malay translation of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) conducted in Malaysia with a community sample of ethnic Malays and Chinese adults. The study found that the Malay BAS-2 had a one-dimensional factor structure with adequate internal consistency, partial sex and ethnic invariance, and evidence of construct validity, though associations between body appreciation and BMI were equivocal (significant in women but not in men).

section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of a Malay translation of the BAS-2 in Malaysian adults. The study found that BAS-2 scores had a one-dimensional factor structure in both women and men, achieved partial sex and ethnic invariance, and demonstrated adequate construct and incremental validity. Body appreciation was significantly associated with life satisfaction and subjective happiness in both genders, though associations with BMI were equivocal (significant in women but not men).
